name: View-dependent data loading
aliases: Level-of-detail based geometry and texture loading
definition: A technique to enable interactive exploration of massive datasets on low-cost hardware by loading only the spatial extent and resolution necessary for the current camera view, reducing data requests and facilitating navigation.
summary: View-dependent data loading dynamically selects the spatial extent and resolution level for volumetric rendering based on the camera's frustum and screen pixel density, avoiding the overhead of precomputed hierarchies.
